note: Focused on English, Japanese, Korean, and Chinese providers; unknown language metadata is kept for manual review. Torrentio is excluded because Limitless is intended to remain HTTPS/direct-stream focused when P2P is disabled. AnikotoTV is pinned to the Asura Synthesis implementation because it reports stream variants directly as SUB/DUB without the mixed English/Japanese labels seen in the All-in-One copy. Cineby is pinned to Limitless Native Ports for source-matched subtitle support. AniZone is pinned to the alias-aware Limitless port so English titles can resolve to Japanese romanized site names such as Youjo Senki II while preserving source subtitles. AnimeKai is explicitly pinned to the proven All-in-One lookup engine until subtitle-only improvements can be applied without replacing episode discovery.
